headline: Google Vids adds custom digital avatars with Gemini AI
summary: Create AI videos with your likeness, voice, and prompts
details: Google Vids now allows users to create custom digital avatars that look and sound like them based on a selfie and voice recording. The feature uses Google's Gemini Omni AI model to generate videos.
The AI model can combine written prompts and reference images to create videos. It can also edit existing videos, such as swapping backgrounds or fixing lighting.
The personal avatars are tied to the user's Google account, watermarked with SynthID, and limited to users in certain regions aged 18 or older.
caption:
Can you star in your own AI videos? Google Vids says yes

Google Vids now allows users to create custom digital avatars that look and sound like them based on a selfie and voice recording. The feature uses Google's Gemini Omni AI model to generate videos.

The AI model can combine written prompts and reference images to create videos. It can also edit existing videos, such as swapping backgrounds or fixing lighting.

The personal avatars are tied to the user's Google account, watermarked with SynthID, and limited to users in certain regions aged 18 or older.

#Google #AI #GoogleVids #Gemini

Source: TechCrunch
